note: One row per stored network, body, parallel, branch (Demux), Mux and IL state measured live (openspec ide-model-mapping 2.2), CODESYS 3.5.21.40 64-bit, English. Each state is one PROGRAM: the editor's own commands drew it (InsertAssign, InsertContact, InsertBox; ToggleNetworkOutCommentState, InsertLabel, InsertNetwork(Below)Command, ChangeText on a title, comment, label or IL cell, SetParallelBranchPoint, ToggleParallelModeCommand, InsertBranch, ViewAsIL/LD/FBD: each command's own Enabled, batch arguments and ExecuteBatch on the focused cell, `log`; `options` names an editor option set for that state alone, e.g. EnableIL, and restored), and a state no command makes was then set through the object model (`muts`). `dialogs` are the IDE's own dialogs the state raised. `stored` is the body as stored: its view mode, NetworkListComment, BranchCounter and ValidIds, and each network's header, IL state, IL lines and trees; `measured`: the build with every state's PROGRAM called, a 60-scan simulation run from a driver with `a` high 2 scans of 4 (`v=n/m`: scans v was TRUE, of them with `a` high; `t.n=last N`: the FB's count after the run), the structured code the compiler is handed, the editor's picture (cell tree with each cell's marks, hashed) and the marks it draws. `live`: saved, closed, reopened and the same. `pull` is what Volt shows from the %LANGUAGE line on; regenerate with VOLT_WRITE_CLASS_STATES=1 dotnet test test/Volt.Ide.Codesys.Tests --filter CodesysClassStatesTests. `faults`: states the IDE did not store or could not hand to the compiler.
